declarations.name: SlButton
declarations.summary: Buttons represent actions that are available to the user.

members.name: variant
members.description: The button's theme variant.

members.name: size
members.description: The button's size.

members.name: caret
members.description: Draws the button with a caret. Used to indicate that the button triggers a dropdown menu or similar behavior.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables the button.

members.name: loading
members.description: Draws the button in a loading state.

members.name: outline
members.description: Draws an outlined button.

members.name: pill
members.description: Draws a pill-style button with rounded edges.

members.name: circle
members.description:
Draws a circular icon button. When this attribute is present, the button expects a single `<sl-icon>` in the
default slot.

members.name: type
members.description:
The type of button. Note that the default value is `button` instead of `submit`, which is opposite of how native
`<button>` elements behave. When the type is `submit`, the button will submit the surrounding form.

members.name: name
members.description:
The name of the button, submitted as a name/value pair with form data, but only when this button is the submitter.
This attribute is ignored when `href` is present.

members.name: value
members.description:
The value of the button, submitted as a pair with the button's name as part of the form data, but only when this
button is the submitter. This attribute is ignored when `href` is present.

members.name: href
members.description: When set, the underlying button will be rendered as an `<a>` with this `href` instead of a `<button>`.

members.name: target
members.description: Tells the browser where to open the link. Only used when `href` is present.

members.name: rel
members.description:
When using `href`, this attribute will map to the underlying link's `rel` attribute. Unlike regular links, the
default is `noreferrer noopener` to prevent security exploits. However, if you're using `target` to point to a
specific tab/window, this will prevent that from working correctly. You can remove or change the default value by
setting the attribute to an empty string or a value of your choice, respectively.

members.name: download
members.description: Tells the browser to download the linked file as this filename. Only used when `href` is present.

members.name: form
members.description:
The "form owner" to associate the button with. If omitted, the closest containing form will be used instead. The
value of this attribute must be an id of a form in the same document or shadow root as the button.

members.name: formAction
members.description: Used to override the form owner's `action` attribute.

members.name: formEnctype
members.description: Used to override the form owner's `enctype` attribute.

members.name: formMethod
members.description: Used to override the form owner's `method` attribute.

members.name: formNoValidate
members.description: Used to override the form owner's `novalidate` attribute.

members.name: formTarget
members.description: Used to override the form owner's `target` attribute.

members.name: validity
members.description: Gets the validity state object

members.name: validationMessage
members.description: Gets the validation message

members.name: click
members.description: Simulates a click on the button.

members.name: focus
members.description: Sets focus on the button.

members.name: blur
members.description: Removes focus from the button.

members.name: checkValidity
members.description: Checks for validity but does not show a validation message. Returns `true` when valid and `false` when invalid.

members.name: getForm
members.description: Gets the associated form, if one exists.

members.name: reportValidity
members.description: Checks for validity and shows the browser's validation message if the control is invalid.

members.name: setCustomValidity
members.description: Sets a custom validation message. Pass an empty string to restore validity.

declarations.name: SlRelativeTime
declarations.summary: Outputs a localized time phrase relative to the current date and time.

members.name: date
members.description:
The date from which to calculate time from. If not set, the current date and time will be used. When passing a
string, it's strongly recommended to use the ISO 8601 format to ensure timezones are handled correctly. To convert
a date to this format in JavaScript, use [`date.toISOString()`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Date/toISOString).

members.name: format
members.description: The formatting style to use.

members.name: numeric
members.description:
When `auto`, values such as "yesterday" and "tomorrow" will be shown when possible. When `always`, values such as
"1 day ago" and "in 1 day" will be shown.

members.name: sync
members.description: Keep the displayed value up to date as time passes.
